tailwinds.headline: Tesla stock jumps 5% on better-than-expected vehicle deliveries report
tailwinds.summary: Tesla reported Q3 vehicle deliveries of 486,532, exceeding production and market expectations, driving a strong 5% stock rally.

tailwinds.headline: Tesla Wins Denmark Green Light For FSD Expansion — But TSLA Stock Slips
tailwinds.summary: Regulatory approval was granted in Denmark for the expansion of Tesla's Full Self-Driving technology, marking a positive step for international software monetization.

headwinds.headline: TSLA Stock On Track For Worst Week In A Year On Fresh Roadster Delay As Musk’s April Promise Fades
headwinds.summary: Delays regarding the next-generation Roadster continue to mount, frustrating retail investors and contributing to weekly downward pressure.

headwinds.headline: TSLA Stock: Tesla Doubles EU Registrations In May But BYD Still Leads With Over 26K Units
headwinds.summary: Despite doubling EU registrations, Tesla faces stiff competition in Europe where competitor BYD maintains the leading position in unit sales.

catalysts.headline: TSLA Stock Hits Nearly 3-Week High: Nvidia Win Adds Muscle To ‘Physical AI’ Pivot Despite Optimus Delays
catalysts.summary: Tesla's pivot toward physical AI and autonomous systems gains technical support following hardware achievements, driving shares to a three-week high.

catalysts.headline: TSLA Stock Cools Overnight After Miami Robotaxi Rally — But Morgan Stanley Sees 30,000-Vehicle Fleet By 2030
catalysts.summary: Analyst projections point to a massive scaling of the Robotaxi fleet by 2030, reinforcing the long-term autonomous service narrative.

risks.headline: TSLA Stock Slips Overnight: Gary Black Says SpaceX Can’t Afford Tesla – ‘The Math Won’t Pass Muster’
risks.summary: Market commentary highlights the financial impracticability of a potential merger between SpaceX and Tesla, raising corporate governance concerns.

risks.headline: TSLA Stock Rises Overnight: JPMorgan Says Tesla-SpaceX Merger Looks ‘Coherent On Paper’ — But China Approval Risks Loom
risks.summary: While a Tesla-SpaceX combination is viewed theoretically as coherent, any such move introduces severe regulatory and approval hurdles in critical markets like China.
